preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.
The sum of edge weights is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.
The vertices connected by an edge are between 1 and n, inclusive.
The vertices connected by an edge are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output is a floating-point number representing the minimum possible diameter of the tree.
The absolute or relative error of the output does not exceed 10^-6.
